nodes.label: `done_at`: when a card last arrived in Done. The archive used to sort on…
A hand-made card accepted, told, and sitting unlocked in Finish.
The rules evict a Done card the moment a step re-opens; the stamp goes with it,…
A schema that ran every migration but never the `done_at` one, so…
A card archived before the event log existed keeps the order the archive…
The app writes the stamp itself from then on; a restart must not overwrite it…
